title: A toolpath entering the 155 mm triangle at tower 1
rationale: The groove ends at (60, 60), inside Z1(155) (safety-model 5.1): T-TOWER, which the vendor also refused before any angle search (spec 08). The wheels cannot follow the tool into the corner, so W-AREA and B-TOWER also fail; T-TOWER is a tool check and does not depend on the heading.
